name: lolPing Lite
description: Desktop-wide ping and local emote wheels with native sound, offline emote packs and DBX-integrated settings.
releaseNotes: Hide empty overlays and lower idle WebView2 memory use while preserving loaded windows. Bound animation/audio caches, coalesce settings writes, avoid thumbnail reloads and gesture cancellation for appearance edits, and clarify pause/resume states. Code is MIT licensed; Riot game assets and the upstream icon are excluded from that license.
